categories.main_business_segments: Henan Shuanghui Investment & Development Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the meat industry, covering the entire meat production chain including feed production, livestock breeding, slaughtering, meat processing, packaging, seasoning production, and commercial retail. The company focuses on fresh pork products, packaged meat products, and fresh poultry products, supported by a diversified product portfolio including ham sausages, cooked meat, convenience foods, and traditional Chinese dishes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as world-class pig slaughtering and cold-cutting production lines, cold chain logistics, and automated poultry processing lines. It emphasizes mechanization, automation, standardization, and digitalization in production, with ISO9001, HACCP, and ISO22000 quality management systems. R&D focuses on product innovation, intelligent manufacturing, precise preservation technologies, and development of products suited to Chinese culinary habits.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shuanghui serves a broad customer base including retail chains, supermarkets, restaurants, food processing factories, and wholesale markets. Its products cater to diverse consumption scenarios, targeting both traditional and emerging channels such as e-commerce platforms. The company’s key markets are domestic Chinese consumers with growing demand for quality, convenience, and health-conscious meat products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with over 30 modern meat processing bases in 18 provinces including Henan, Heilongjiang, Hebei, Shandong, Anhui, Hubei, Jiangxi, Shanghai, Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Guangxi. It also engages in international trade and has global resource integration through its parent company Rotary Vortex Limited and ultimate controller Rise Grand Group Limited.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shuanghui operates across the entire meat supply chain, from upstream feed production and livestock breeding, through midstream slaughtering and meat processing, to downstream packaging, seasoning production, commercial retail, and export. It is a fully integrated player with strong upstream and downstream capabilities, including self-breeding and contract farming.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include industrialization, diversification, internationalization, and digitalization. R&D focuses on enhancing product quality, preservation technologies, intelligent manufacturing, and developing products aligned with Chinese dietary habits. It invests in innovation platforms, maintains a large R&D team, and pursues automation and smart factory upgrades to improve efficiency and product competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of meat products including fresh pork, packaged meat, and poultry products. Sales channels include direct sales, distributor networks, retail chains, e-commerce platforms, and foodservice. The company also earns income from related services such as seasoning production, packaging materials, and financial services through subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shuanghui is a leading brand in China’s meat industry, recognized as a national key enterprise with strong brand value ranked among the top 100 Chinese brands. It holds a dominant market position in pork consumption and meat processing with significant scale advantages and extensive distribution networks. Competitors include other large domestic meat processors and international meat companies operating in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 59.56 billion, a slight decrease of 0.55% year-on-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 4.99 billion, down 1.26%. Total assets reached RMB 37.29 billion, with steady growth in cash flow from operations. The company maintains a strong financial position with a stable asset-liability ratio around 42.8%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shuanghui emphasizes product quality, safety, and innovation, leveraging advanced technology and strict quality control systems to ensure fresh, nutritious, and diverse meat products. Its integrated supply chain and extensive distribution network enable timely delivery and broad market coverage. The brand is well-known for meeting evolving consumer demands for convenience, health, and traditional Chinese flavors, supported by continuous R&D and digital transformation.
